defects.reproduction: A missing or briefly stale projection permitted a new synthetic continuation.
defects.fix: Require exact current projection before new send.

defects.reproduction: A newer unsupported database generation fell back to cached older state.
defects.fix: Read only newest generation, rediscovered per read.

defects.reproduction: Pause or cancel committed during final source checks before the transport still launched.
defects.fix: Recheck consent under write lock through queue-process launch; release before receipt wait.

defects.reproduction: Three claims on one interruption counted as one daily claim.
defects.fix: Conservatively count durable attempt totals until latest claim expires.

defects.reproduction: Unreadable or malformed journal allowed following sweep to delete the good old copy.
defects.fix: Refuse before any restoration or sweep.

defects.reproduction: Plugin removal failure deleted retry runtime and ownership proof.
defects.fix: Retain runtime when external removal fails.
